Compare your day with one day type, activity by activity

compare_day.Rd

Shows how many more or fewer hours you spent in each activity category than the average day of one day type. This explains why your day matched, or did not match, a type in match_my_day().

Usage

compare_day(day, type)

Arguments

day

A named numeric vector of the hours spent in each activity category, e.g. c(sleep = 8, work = 9). Names must come from activity_categories$category. Categories left out count as zero.

type

The day type to compare with, one of day_types$day_type.

Value

A tibble with one row per activity category and columns category, label, you and typical (hours) and difference (you - typical, hours), from the largest to the smallest absolute difference.

Examples

my_day <- c(sleep = 7.5, personal_care = 1, eating = 1, work = 9,
            housework = 1, screen = 2.5, travel = 1.5, exercise = 0.5)
compare_day(my_day, "Work day")
